WITH flow_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        recordregistry AS flow_id,
        bwidthpct * datasizemb / durmin AS bsi,
        successpct::numeric / (errtally + 1) AS dte,
        successpct::numeric / (errtally + 1) * (1 - rtrytally::numeric / (errtally + 1)) AS dfsr,
        orignation || ' -> ' || destnation AS transfer_path
    FROM dataflow
)
SELECT 
    flow_id,
    transfer_path,
    ROUND(CAST(dfsr * dte AS numeric), 2) AS dfsi
FROM flow_metrics
WHERE bsi > 50 AND dte < 1.0
ORDER BY bsi DESC
LIMIT 10;
